highlights.headline: Commission prolongs State aid framework to support sectors affected by Middle East crisis until June 2027
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 25 Nov 2026 The European Commission has prolonged the Middle East Crisis Temporary State aid Framework (METSAF) by six months until 30 June 2027.

highlights.headline: EU plans €50 billion sovereign tech equity fund to boost quantum technology
highlights.summary: The European Commission proposed a tech fund with a target size of €50 billion to boost quantum computing efforts. The bloc aims to keep up with the US and China in the global race.

items.title: Fact check: Deepfakes and 'US abandons Taiwan' claims spread ahead of vote
